title: The doubt, then the budget evidence

members.role: the doubt drawn ABOVE as a chain (who pays -> what they buy -> what it should return), on the claim's words
on 'no value' the last link fails - the X on its arrow; the diagram stands above for the rest of the beat
the evidence answers BELOW: the budget as bars in one unit (what it was for, how long it lasted), growing in the card as the spender is named
on the spend's verb the money runs into the middle node along the standing arrow (coins)
the source card LAST, in the bars' slot: the record types and its own highlighted phrase lands as the narrator says it

does: The doubt is drawn as a diagram above with its failing link, the budget answers as bars below, and the source's own record lands last in the same slot, its phrase highlighted on the word.

use_when.act: EXPLAINS - a doubt answered by a budget, then by its source (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R34)
use_when.shape: named things + two numbers: a 2-4 node chain, two bars in one unit, one sourced record
use_when.use: a claim that spend creates no value, then the spender's own numbers, then an insider's words (H row 11: Karp's tokens, Uber's budget spent by April, the COO's 'harder to justify')
use_when.dont: the diagram is not the question the bars answer (the guide's don't); a dollar figure the record does not carry (the budget is in months here); the record's highlighted phrase is not the one the narrator says
